agyos_skill.instructions: - Use when auditing content quality, readability, thin content risk, or E-E-A-T signals. - Use when the user wants a content-focused SEO review rather than a full technical audit. - Use when checking whether content is structured and trustworthy enough for search and AI citation. Read `seo/references/eeat-framework.md` for full criteria. - Original research, case studies, before/after results - Personal anecdotes, process documentation - Unique data, proprietary insights - Photos/videos from direct experience - Author credentials, certifications, bio - Professional background relevant to topic - Technical depth appropriate for audience - Accurate, well-sourced claims - External citations, backlinks from authoritative sources - Brand mentions, industry recognition - Published in recognized outlets - Cited by other experts - Contact information, physical address - Privacy policy, terms of service - Customer testimonials, reviews - Date stamps, transparent corrections - Secure site (HTTPS) Compare against page type minimums: | Page Type | Minimum | |-----------|---------| | Homepage | 500 |
